result.title: DOCK: Dual-Stream-Inspired Self-Supervised Object-Centric Representations Grounded in Robot Kinematics
result.summary: Latent-space planners select actions by comparing the embedding of a predicted future image with that of a goal image. This assumes that distance in the embedding reflects how far the scene is from the goal. We profile this assumption with simulator-executed futures, which removes prediction error. For six frozen DINO and V-JEPA encoders, feature distance barely tracks the object's distance to its goal: the rank correlation is at most 0.11, against 0.87 for object-mask centroids. It is dominated by background and robot patches, and frozen-feature readouts capture the arm far better than the object. Inspired by the ventral (what) and dorsal (where/how) visual streams, we propose DOCK, which learns an object representation whose changes agree with measured physical motion. A grasped object moves with the gripper, so forward kinematics on the joint angles gives a proxy for the object's displacement without annotation. From 9,951 held-object transport trajectories in 21 simulated kitchen scenes, we mine 404K displacement pairs and train three components: an object token pooled from patch features (what), a spatial ruler that makes differences of readout coordinates equal to measured displacements (where), and a dynamics predictor over object tokens (how). Used as a planning cost, the learned representation places the object in 15 of 21 tasks, as many as an oracle that reads the true object position, while mask geometry reaches 10 and frozen feature distance 9. It still solves the most tasks when the unseen robot arm is visible, and its ranking transfers to held-out layouts with unseen object instances and categories without any adaptation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文先用仿真未来帧检验「潜在距离反映接近目标程度」这一假设，发现六个冻结 DINO/V-JEPA 编码器的特征距离与物体真实位移几乎不相关，且被背景和机械臂主导；随后借用腹侧/背侧双流思路，以机器人正运动学作为无标注监督，学习由物体 token、空间标尺和动力学预测器组成的对象中心表示，并作为规划代价使用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「潜在距离由背景与机械臂而非任务物体主导」的诊断，与 LVR 关注的 latent 相似度中内容成分、视觉证据筛选和任务必要信息是否保留直接相关，可供核查 latent 成本或匹配信号是否真正编码了物体状态。
